subject: The 2AM setting that kills static
preview_text: Your headphones are noisy. Here's the fix that works right now.
body_paragraphs: It's 2AM. You're deep into a podcast, and the background hum is louder than the host. That's not your headphones—it's the audio source. Most boosters amplify everything, including the noise. Volume Booster Pro doesn't.
Right now is the perfect time to use the EQ preset labeled 'Clean.' It cuts the low-end rumble and high-frequency hiss, leaving just the signal. No ads, no interruptions—just a slider that works.
Open the app, tap the EQ icon, and select 'Clean.' Within seconds, your audio goes from muddy to clear. This feature was built for people like you—power users who want control without clutter.

The slider is waiting for you. Open Volume Booster Pro now and try the 'Clean' preset. You'll hear the difference before the next sentence ends. P.S. The 'Bass Boost' preset works great for music—but 'Clean' is the secret weapon for podcasts and calls.
